_comment: BGM_제작발주서.md v2.1 → ACE-Step 1.5 요청서. name = Resources/CoastRun/BGM/<name>.wav. stems = Demucs(htdemucs_6s) 소스 묶음 → _a/_b/_c(_d). seed 고정 = 같은 결과 재현.
common_tail: instrumental, no vocals, no singing, hand-drawn animation film score, Korean seaside town, clean mix, no fade in

tracks.name: BGM_Menu
tracks.prompt: gentle summer acoustic, coastal breeze, hopeful, anime slice-of-life, soft acoustic guitar strum, warm synth pad, distant waves, light and airy, steady loopable groove, recurring three-note motif D E F# on guitar inner voice

tracks.name: BGM_Menu_Cleared
tracks.prompt: same quiet summer coastal theme but hollow: piano and soft pad only, no guitar, no drums, sparse, something is missing, steady loopable, recurring three-note motif D E F# on piano

tracks.name: BGM_CH1
tracks.prompt: endless runner video game soundtrack like Subway Surfers, upbeat energetic electronic pop, punchy four-on-the-floor drums, driving synth bass, bright plucky synth lead with a catchy hook, hand claps, summer beach vibe, fast and fun, big and loud, three-note motif D E F# in the lead hook, loopable

tracks.name: BGM_CH2
tracks.prompt: endless runner video game soundtrack like Subway Surfers, festival energy, fast tribal drum kit and toms with electronic kick, driving synth bass, bright brass-like synth stabs, catchy plucky lead hook, dense and bright, high energy, loopable

tracks.name: BGM_CH3
tracks.prompt: endless runner video game soundtrack like Subway Surfers, darker driving electronic, punchy drums, deep synth bass, cool reverberant industrial pads, sharp arpeggiated synth lead hook, minor key tension but still fast and fun, loopable

tracks.name: BGM_CH4
tracks.prompt: endless runner video game soundtrack like Subway Surfers, euphoric sunset synthwave pop, punchy drums, warm driving bass, big lush pads, soaring bright synth lead hook, hopeful and fast, the most beautiful and loud track, loopable

tracks.name: BGM_CH5
tracks.prompt: endless runner video game soundtrack, restrained dusk electronic, soft but steady punchy drums, deep quiet bass, purple ambient pads, sparse plucky arpeggio lead, held breath, minor key, still moving forward, loopable

tracks.name: BGM_CH5_d
tracks.prompt: single sustained low drone on the note B, distant reverb tail, almost silence, no rhythm, no melody, no chord changes, very slow breathing swell, dark ambient

tracks.name: BGM_Cine_Prologue
tracks.prompt: cinematic opening, piano states a three-note motif D E F# that never reaches its last note, phrase stops on the seventh, B minor trying to reach D major and failing, thin strings, summer morning light, restrained, no drums

tracks.name: BGM_Cine_CH2_Open
tracks.prompt: cinematic cue, festival crowd pressure, dense percussion swell, bright but claustrophobic, building tension, short

tracks.name: BGM_Cine_CH3_Open
tracks.prompt: cinematic cue under a bridge, space emptying out, sparse reverberant pad, single guitar harmonics, cold, minor, short

tracks.name: BGM_Cine_CH4_Open
tracks.prompt: cinematic cue, entering the elevated highway, sky beginning to glow orange, warm pads opening up, gentle rising strings, hopeful, short

tracks.name: BGM_Cine_CH5_Open
tracks.prompt: cinematic cue, she already knows but keeps going, blue hour, single piano note repeating, deep quiet pad, resolve without hope, short

tracks.name: BGM_Cine_CH1_Close
tracks.prompt: cinematic cue, still bright afternoon, acoustic guitar and piano, modulating gently from D major to A major, warm, light, three-note motif D E F# passed between instruments

tracks.name: BGM_Cine_CH2_Close
tracks.prompt: cinematic cue, four o'clock, time growing heavy, acoustic guitar slowing, moving from A major toward F# minor, low pad entering, the first weight

tracks.name: BGM_Cine_CH3_Close
tracks.prompt: cinematic cue, deja vu, the same three-note motif D E F# from the summer run quoted exactly but slower and in F# minor, hollow guitar, piano echo, unsettling familiarity, restrained

tracks.name: BGM_Cine_CH4_Close
tracks.prompt: cinematic cue in five parts: 0-35s warm sunset pad afterglow still beautiful; 35-50s the music thins, instruments drop out one by one; 50-58s complete silence, nothing; 58-80s the three-note motif enters as fragments in D major then is dragged down a semitone into B minor; 80-90s only low bass remains and fades. no drums, no swell, no crescendo

tracks.name: BGM_Memory_Warm
tracks.prompt: nostalgic acoustic guitar and piano duet, summer memory, warm and close, short reverb, bright high end, the three-note motif D E F# played as a complete resolved gentle melody, tender, short

tracks.name: BGM_Memory_Mid
tracks.prompt: solo piano with faint strings, warm but distant, medium reverb, the three-note motif D E F# played as a complete resolved melody, tender, a little far away, short

tracks.name: BGM_Memory_Cold
tracks.prompt: solo piano only, very long cathedral reverb, distant, high frequencies rolled off, low-pass filtered, the three-note motif D E F# resolves but sounds unreachable and far, cold, short

tracks.name: BGM_End_Arrival
tracks.prompt: near silence for 90 seconds: only a very low sub pulse every two seconds like a distant aviation warning light, faint wind through pampas grass, no melody, no chords, no drums; then in the final ten seconds a single piano note, once, and nothing else

tracks.name: BGM_End_Letter
tracks.prompt: emotional piano letter reading, solo piano for the first 30 seconds restating an unfinished phrase, thin strings enter softly, the melody arrives at its final note for the first time, restrained, no swell, no crescendo, no drums, ends on a held D add6 chord D F# A B with D in the bass, unresolved sixth held to the end, cinematic quiet

tracks.name: BGM_End_Descent
tracks.prompt: minimal piano and very shallow pad holding one D add6 chord, no resolution, no drums, three or four slow single notes added over a minute like village lights turning on, walking down a hill at dusk, loopable, calm

tracks.name: BGM_Sting_Radio
tracks.prompt: old song playing on a 2am AM radio, lo-fi mono, band pass 300Hz to 4kHz, tape hiss, small band arrangement of a gentle three-note theme D E F#, warm and distant, the final chord D F# A B voiced as B minor seventh with B in the bass, not sad, just an old song, no fade
